FIELDS.NAME: Green Valley Grocers
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Green Valley Road, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62701-5678
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Valley Grocers operates a retail grocery store located in Springfield, Illinois, providing a wide range of food products including fresh produce, canned goods, dairy, and meats. Our store occupies a spacious area of over 3,000 square feet, designed to enhance customer experience and facilitate efficient inventory management. We prioritize food safety compliance; all staff undergo regular training to meet health regulations and uphold sanitation standards. Our operations do not include extensive on-site cooking to minimize fire hazards, ensuring a safe shopping environment. We maintain a reliable supply chain through established vendor relationships and ensure rigorous inventory turnover, which helps reduce spoilage and guarantees product availability. Moreover, we have implemented effective pest control measures and remain compliant with all local food safety regulations, reinforcing our commitment to public health and operational integrity.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a minor electrical issue caused a localized fire in the storage area, leading to the disposal of spoiled inventory. The total loss amounted to $3,000. The situation was promptly addressed, with repairs made and local fire department inspections passed, ensuring compliance with safety standards. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed Safe, Grade 1, with electronic lock and time-delay features.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System with Regular Monitoring and 24/7 Security Patrols
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost, actual cost value of inventory

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking these certificates.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Green Valley Grocers is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as our operations are focused solely on retail food sales without extensive processing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Green Valley Grocers does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its operations. The focus is solely on retail grocery sales, minimizing any associated liabilities.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Green Valley Grocers does not have any catastrophe exposure as their operations focus solely on retail grocery sales, and they have implemented effective risk management protocols to address potential hazards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Green Valley Grocers has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong ethical standard and commitment to compliance in all operations.
